 Featured Matchup: Wizards vs. Bulls
 The Washington Wizards (5-11) travel to the United Center in Chicago to face the Chicago Bulls (4-10) on Friday, November 20, 2026 at 8:00 PM ET, with both clubs playing on one day of rest following Thursday night action. Washington enters after a 103-99 road win over the Raptors on November 19, while Chicago arrives off a 137-107 road victory against the Nets on the same night. When these teams met earlier in the 2026-27 season on October 24, Washington edged Chicago 124-120 at the United Center.
 From a roster and statistical standpoint, Chicago leans on Norman Powell (21.3 points per game), Matas Buzelis (15.1 points per game), Jalen Smith (13.4 points and 7.9 rebounds per game), and Josh Giddey (8.5 assists per game), while dealing with frontcourt absences such as Caleb Wilson (hand) and Noa Essengue listed day-to-day (wrist). Washington counters with Anthony Davis averaging 24.6 points and 10.1 rebounds per game, AJ Dybantsa at 16.3 points per game, Trae Young dishing 8.9 assists per game, and Alex Sarr shooting 53.9% from the field, though Justin Champagnie, Reece Beekman, Tristan Vukcevic, and Jamir Watkins remain sidelined. Frontcourt rebounding, paint protection, and late-game execution will be pivotal factors for participants evaluating positions in Wizards vs. Bulls event markets, though no outcome is ever certain.
